title: This FedEx CEO stayed at the company for 30+ years: Here’s why
transcript: When I joined this company, I had no idea, no concept that this is where I would be. It was a depth of recession and I didn't, you know, I was almost very fortunate to have received an offer at that point at the lowest level in this company as an associate marketing analyst in in FedEx in the international business in 1991. I didn't know where Memphis really was. I didn't know a single person in the city. I found myself in a place where I really loved it and the cultural values of this company and my personal values meshed. We have a phenomenal founder, chairman of the company and I always felt that someone was through my career was looking at my comfort zone and the minute I got a little bit comfortable something changed. So I was given new and different you know opportunities uh over the course of my career. I felt no reason whatsoever to leave this company. There's new opportunities and it's always exciting for me. Continuous learning is just part of who I am.
